check: 24h profile will actually reach its window (goal item 5, decisive risk)
risk: StressFixture.passed requires durationMet, and the controller stops when its pending queue drains. The position list is finite (MAX_PENDING = 65536), so without refill the run would end early and be failed for not certifying its requested duration.
codeConfirmsTheFix: refills is a plain AtomicLong counter with no cap, so the count is unbounded by design
the surrounding comment records the failure it fixed: a 24h request was on course to end after roughly 4.5h
interpretation: Six refills so far, roughly every 19-23 minutes, each logging a remainingSeconds that counts down from 86400. That is the behaviour that distinguishes a full-window profile from one that quietly drained its queue, and it is visible while the run is still going rather than only in the final report.
